title: Single hieratic sign, D. Assiut N13.1 TS7 (AKU HT 33545)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Svenja A. Gülden, Ursula Verhoeven; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 33545

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 33545; AKU grapheme R0130 (AKU GR 531). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: R8 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 547. Occurrence: line 6; find place Gebel Assiut al-gharbi; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 24.6 x 6.5 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 20. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Svenja A. Gülden, Ursula Verhoeven. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
